about_the_game:
Sigils of Nightfall is a roguelike deckbuilder where you fight for survival in turn-based battles, shaped by merciless decisions and resource management. Set in a gothic apocalyptic world inspired by the acclaimed tabletop RPG MÖRK BORG, every struggle is a slow descent into ruin.

You are a condemned soul, shackled within Mountain’s Penance, a dungeon of rot and despair. Beneath its stone veins, a cult festers, conducting blasphemous rites to awaken an entity that will devour the last light of the world, bringing about the Nightfall.

Key Features

  • One-Shot RPG with Roguelike Deckbuilding: Choose from flawed, tormented characters. Build your deck from ashes and ruin. Combine cards and abilities into devastating synergies or reckless chaos, until you rise or rot.

  • A new Fast-Paced, First-Person Dungeon Crawler: Face grotesque enemies in turn-based battles that demand strategy and sacrifice. Every foe is a challenge that requires a unique approach to defeat.

  • Inspired by the Award-Winning Tabletop RPG Mörk Borg: Step into an apocalyptic world filled with filth, heresy, and despair. Explore oppressive environments imbued with existential dread, moral ambiguity, and the visceral horror of a dark fantasy setting.

  • Grim Art Style: Unique and gory character art by Thiago Lehmann, featuring twisted cultists, undead abominations, and other unspeakable beasts.

  • An Unstable and Chaotic Dungeon: The map itself is a trial, and every choice carves your fate. Choose the next dungeon room, face unexpected events, weigh risk against reward, and reap the benefits of your decisions.

  • Face the Nightfall: The sigils will shatter, reshaping your playthrough into something new, unstable, and cruel. Adapt, exploit, and endure before everything crumbles into the void.

  • Extensive Content: Discover forbidden knowledge and collect powerful items that enhance your abilities and open new strategic possibilities. Hundreds of cards, trinkets, and endless ways to twist your fate. Enough to damn you a thousand times over.

The seal has broken. Defenses have fallen. Chaos is unleashed. The entity awakens, hungering for blood. Will you grasp the last scraps of light, or embrace the dark powers to survive?

content_descriptors.notes: The game explores themes of existential horror, psychological torment, and moral ambiguity, with disturbing imagery and scenarios. It includes references to dark rituals within its dark fantasy setting. Players sensitive to these themes should be aware that the content is designed to create a deeply immersive and unsettling experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 @ 3.3GHz (4th Generation)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660 TI or AMD Radeon R7 370, with a minimum of 3GB of VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Sigils of Nightfall is a roguelike deckbuilder that combines dungeon crawling with elements of the award-winning RPG, Mörk Borg. Embark on a dark journey, improve your character, and survive the horrors that will unleash the world's end.
supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, French, Italian, German, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
